player.sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(p.draft_pick) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN p.mvp_awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_winner_count, MAX(t.championship) AS team_titles FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.team_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN p.mvp_awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_winner_count, MAX(t.championship) AS team_titles FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.team_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(p.draft_year) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN p.mvp_awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_winner_count, MAX(t.championship) AS team_titles FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.team_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
